source_title: Que Es Temperatura De Un Producto
snippet_primary: "La temperatura es un concepto utilizado por Hotmart con el fin de informar, simbólicamente, cómo el producto está siendo aceptado en el mercado y cómo les está yendo a los afiliados."
subject_exact: Hotmart help center (Spanish, help.hotmart.com, undated) defines 'temperatura' (temperature) as a Hotmart metric that symbolically indicates how well a product is being accepted in the market and how affiliates are performing with it
local_qualifiers: Hotmart 'temperatura' metric: symbolic indicator of product market acceptance and affiliate performance level
parser_notes: help.hotmart.com/es (undated). 'Temperatura' definition: symbolic metric for product market acceptance + affiliate performance.
